scenario: 目录用 Easy/Medium/Hard 给 30 道拆解分级；13 道 Hard 常见的是 Uber、YouTube、Payment System，Easy 只有 Bitly、Dropbox 这类题。
scenario_en: The catalog ranks 30 breakdowns as Easy, Medium, or Hard; Hard includes Uber, YouTube, and Payment System, while Easy includes Bitly and Dropbox.
q: Hard 题相比 Easy 题，通常在技术判断上多出的核心难点是什么？
q_en: Compared with Easy problems, what extra technical judgment usually makes a Hard problem harder?
options: 需要额外权衡强一致性、地理/实时约束或多组件间的协同
只是要求的代码行数更多，核心存储模型不变
只是接口数量更多，别的判断都一样
只是名字更难记，架构模式和 Easy 题一致
why: 难度差距通常不是代码量，而是要多做几层跨组件权衡；Bitly 只判编码，Uber 要同时判地理匹配和实时调度。
why_en: Hard problems are harder mainly because they stack extra cross-component tradeoffs like consistency, geography, or real-time constraints, not because they need more code.
options_en: They add extra tradeoffs like strong consistency, geography, or real-time constraints across components.
They just require more lines of code; the core storage model stays the same.
They just have more API endpoints; every other judgment is identical.
They just have harder-to-remember names; the architecture pattern is the same.

termDefinitions.meaning: 写入后任何后续读取都能立刻看到最新值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Strong consistency means any read after a write immediately sees the latest value.

scenario: 这四道题都在同一个系统设计题库里，用来对照「问题」和「它真正考的技术判断」。
scenario_en: These four prompts are from the same system design catalog and compare each problem with the technical judgment it actually tests.
q: 以下「问题—核心技术判断」配对，哪些正确？（多选）
q_en: Which problem-to-core-judgment pairs are correct? Select all that apply.
options: Bitly——核心技术判断只有短码生成与重定向，没有强一致性或实时性要求
Dropbox（简化版）——核心技术判断是文件版本与同步元数据，不涉及复杂事务
Ticketmaster——核心技术判断只有短码生成与重定向，没有强一致性或实时性要求
News Aggregator——核心技术判断是抓取聚合与展示第三方内容，不需要强一致写路径
why: Bitly、Dropbox、News Aggregator 的核心判断都相对单一；Ticketmaster 实际要处理并发抢票的锁与事务，判断更多。
why_en: Bitly, Dropbox, and News Aggregator each have one dominant technical judgment, while Ticketmaster additionally needs locking and transactions for concurrent ticket sales.
options_en: Bitly — the only real judgment is short-code generation and redirect, no strong consistency or real-time need.
Dropbox (simplified) — the core judgment is file versioning and sync metadata, no complex transactions.
Ticketmaster — the only real judgment is short-code generation and redirect, no strong consistency or real-time need.
News Aggregator — the core judgment is crawling, aggregating, and displaying third-party content, no strong write consistency needed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把长 URL 映射成的一小段可读字符串。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A short code is a compact string mapped to a long URL.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一组必须整体成功或整体失败的操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transaction is a group of operations that must all succeed or all fail together.

scenario: 你是系统设计新手，第一次想独立走完一遍完整的面试流程，还没建立起「需求→判断→方案」的节奏。
scenario_en: You are new to system design and want to walk through a full interview flow before you have the rhythm of requirement to judgment to design.
q: 为什么应该先挑 Bitly 这类 Easy 题，而不是直接上手 ChatGPT、Payment System 这类 Hard 题？
q_en: Why start with an Easy problem like Bitly instead of jumping straight to Hard problems like ChatGPT or Payment System?
options: Hard 题的题面字数更长，读起来更费时间
Easy 题通常只孤立考一个核心技术判断，便于先练熟完整流程
Easy 题不需要设计 API 和数据模型
Hard 题只在大厂面试里出现，创业公司不考
why: Easy 题把判断收窄到一个点（如编码/元数据），新手能先练熟节奏，再叠加一致性、实时性等多重判断。
why_en: Easy problems isolate one technical judgment, so a beginner can first master the requirement-to-design flow before stacking on consistency and real-time constraints.
whenOtherWins: 如果你已有丰富的分布式系统经验、目标是资深岗位，直接从 Medium/Hard 切入更省时间。
tradeoff: 先练单一判断的完整流程 vs 直接挑战多重判断的深度
options_en: Hard problems just have longer prompts that take more time to read.
Easy problems isolate one core technical judgment, so it's easier to first practice the full flow.
Easy problems don't require designing an API or data model.
Hard problems only show up in big-company interviews, not startups.

scenario: 目录里的本地配送服务（如几十分钟送达的「最后一公里」配送）和普通电商发货是两类不同的系统。
scenario_en: A local delivery service, such as last-mile delivery within tens of minutes, is different from ordinary e-commerce shipping.
q: 本地配送服务和普通电商发货相比，多出的核心技术判断是什么？
q_en: Compared with ordinary e-commerce shipping, what extra technical judgment does local delivery add?
options: 要为已上传视频做多分辨率转码
要支持多人同时编辑同一份文档
要按用户位置匹配附近仓点的库存与配送范围
要对股票买卖单做强一致撮合
why: 本地配送要把用户位置、附近仓点库存、配送时效三者联动判断，普通电商发货不需要这层地理约束。
why_en: Local delivery has to jointly reason about user location, nearby inventory, and delivery time windows, which ordinary e-commerce shipping does not need.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    User["User location"] --> Match["Match nearby warehouses"]
    Match --> Stock["Check local inventory"]
    Stock --> ETA["Compute delivery ETA"]
options_en: Transcode uploaded video into multiple resolutions.
Support multiple users editing the same document at once.
Match user location to the inventory and range of nearby warehouses.
Match stock buy/sell orders with strong consistency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从本地仓点到用户手中的最后一段配送。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The last mile is the final delivery leg from a local warehouse to the customer.

scenario: 价格追踪服务（如持续追踪电商商品历史价格、命中目标价就提醒用户的服务）没有官方实时价格推送可用。
scenario_en: A price tracking service watches e-commerce price history and alerts users when a target price is hit, but there is no official real-time price feed.
q: 这类价格追踪服务的核心技术判断是什么？
q_en: What is the core technical judgment for this kind of price tracking service?
options: 订阅一个官方实时价格推送流，从不主动抓取
只保存最新一次价格，不保留历史
把每次价格都写一条强一致事务，保证多副本瞬间同步
定期轮询抓取价格快照，存成时间序列，命中阈值再触发提醒
why: 没有官方推送时只能定期轮询抓快照；要支持历史价格和降价提醒，就必须按时间序列存储并做阈值比较。
why_en: Without an official push feed, the service must poll for price snapshots on a schedule and store them as a time series to support history and threshold alerts.
options_en: Subscribe to an official real-time price push feed and never poll.
Only keep the latest price and discard history.
Write every price as a strongly consistent transaction synced instantly across replicas.
Poll for price snapshots on a schedule, store them as a time series, and fire alerts when a threshold is crossed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按固定周期主动去源头查询最新数据，而不是等对方推送。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Polling means periodically asking a source for the latest data instead of waiting for it to push updates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按时间顺序记录的一串数据点，用来看历史趋势。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A time series is a sequence of data points ordered by time, used to see trends.

scenario: 这四道题都在同一个题库里，用来对照「问题」和「它真正考的技术判断」。
scenario_en: These four prompts are from the same catalog and are used to match each problem with the technical judgment it really tests.
q: 以下「问题—核心技术判断」配对，哪些正确？（多选）
q_en: Which problem-to-core-judgment pairs are correct? Select all that apply.
options: Ticketmaster——核心判断是并发抢票下的锁与事务串行化
WhatsApp——核心判断是端到端实时消息投递与在线状态
Rate Limiter——核心判断是限流算法与跨节点计数一致性
YouTube——核心判断是并发抢票下的锁与事务串行化
why: Ticketmaster、WhatsApp、Rate Limiter 各自判断不同；YouTube 的真实核心是上传转码与全球分发，不是抢票锁。
why_en: Ticketmaster, WhatsApp, and the rate limiter each test a different judgment, while YouTube's real core is upload, transcoding, and global delivery, not ticket locking.
options_en: Ticketmaster — the core judgment is locking and transaction serialization under concurrent ticket sales.
WhatsApp — the core judgment is end-to-end real-time message delivery and presence.
Rate Limiter — the core judgment is a throttling algorithm with consistent cross-node counting.
YouTube — the core judgment is locking and transaction serialization under concurrent ticket sales.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让并发操作表现得像按某个顺序一个个执行，避免冲突。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Serialization makes concurrent operations behave as if executed one at a time in some order, avoiding conflicts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 标记用户当前是否在线、最近活跃时间的状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Presence is the status that shows whether a user is currently online and when they were last active.

termDefinitions.meaning: 限制单位时间内允许通过的请求数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rate limiting caps how many requests are allowed to pass through in a given time window.

scenario: 这四道题都在同一个题库里，用来对照「问题」和「它真正考的技术判断」。
scenario_en: These four Hard prompts come from the same catalog and compare each problem with the technical judgment it really tests.
q: 以下「问题—核心技术判断」配对，哪些正确？（多选）
q_en: Which problem-to-core-judgment pairs are correct? Select all that apply.
options: Uber——核心判断是海量司机实时位置的地理匹配与调度
Google Docs——核心判断是多用户并发编辑的冲突合并（如 OT/CRDT）
Payment System——核心判断是跨服务的强一致性与幂等性
Yelp——核心判断是多用户并发编辑的冲突合并（如 OT/CRDT）
why: Uber、Google Docs、Payment System 各自判断不同；Yelp 的真实核心是按位置排序的邻近搜索，不是协同编辑合并。
why_en: Uber, Google Docs, and Payment System each test a different judgment, while Yelp's real core is location-ranked proximity search, not collaborative-edit merging.
options_en: Uber — the core judgment is geo-matching and dispatch over massive real-time driver locations.
Google Docs — the core judgment is merging concurrent multi-user edits (e.g. OT/CRDT).
Payment System — the core judgment is cross-service strong consistency and idempotency.
Yelp — the core judgment is merging concurrent multi-user edits (e.g. OT/CRDT).

termDefinitions.meaning: 两种让多人同时编辑同一文档也能合并出一致结果的算法思路。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: OT and CRDT are two algorithm families that let multiple people edit the same document and still converge to a consistent result.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一个请求重复执行多次，结果和只执行一次一样。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotency means repeating the same request multiple times has the same effect as doing it once.

scenario: Dropbox 和 YouTube 都属于「存储与分发文件/媒体」方向，目录把前者标 Easy、后者标 Hard。
scenario_en: Dropbox and YouTube both involve storing and distributing files or media, but the catalog marks Dropbox as Easy and YouTube as Hard.
q: YouTube 比 Dropbox 多出的核心技术判断是什么？
q_en: What core technical judgment does YouTube add beyond Dropbox?
options: 两者判断完全相同，只是数据量更大
YouTube 完全不需要考虑存储成本
YouTube 要转码+全球分发，Dropbox 只需同步
Dropbox 反而更难，因为要处理冲突合并
why: Dropbox 的核心是文件同步与版本元数据；YouTube 还要做转码流水线、CDN 分发和排序，判断层数更多。
why_en: Dropbox mainly needs file sync and version metadata, while YouTube stacks a transcoding pipeline, CDN delivery, and ranking on top of that.
tradeoff: 同步 + 版本元数据（Dropbox） vs 转码 + 全球分发（YouTube）
options_en: Both test exactly the same judgment; only the data volume is larger.
YouTube does not need to consider storage cost at all.
YouTube additionally needs transcoding and global delivery, while Dropbox only needs sync.
Dropbox is actually harder because it must merge edit conflicts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把上传的视频转换成不同分辨率和编码格式，适配不同设备和网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Transcoding converts an uploaded video into different resolutions and codecs to fit various devices and networks.

scenario: FB News Feed 和 Instagram 都属于「feed 流」方向，目录把前者标 Medium、后者标 Hard。
scenario_en: FB News Feed and Instagram are both feed-style systems, but the catalog marks News Feed as Medium and Instagram as Hard.
q: Instagram 比 FB News Feed 多出的核心技术判断是什么？
q_en: What core technical judgment does Instagram add beyond FB News Feed?
options: 两者判断完全相同，只是界面风格不同
Instagram 不需要排序，只按时间倒序
News Feed 反而更难，因为要处理好友关系图
Instagram 要额外处理媒体存储，并多维护一条独立的 Explore 排序
why: News Feed 的核心是好友关系 fan-out 与排序；Instagram 还要扛媒体存储转码，并多维护一条 Explore 发现排序。
why_en: News Feed's core is friend-graph fan-out and ranking, while Instagram additionally carries media storage plus a separate Explore discovery ranking funnel.
tradeoff: 关系图 fan-out 排序（News Feed） vs 媒体存储 + 独立发现排序（Instagram）
options_en: Both test the same judgment; only the visual style differs.
Instagram needs no ranking at all, just reverse-chronological order.
News Feed is actually harder because it must process the friend graph.
Instagram additionally handles media storage and maintains a separate Explore ranking funnel.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一条内容主动推送/写入到所有关注者的 feed 里的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fan-out is the process of pushing or writing one piece of content into every follower's feed.

scenario: WhatsApp、FB Live Comments、Google Docs 都要给用户「实时」体验，Bitly 只是一次性跳转，不需要长连接。
scenario_en: WhatsApp, FB Live Comments, and Google Docs need a realtime user experience, while Bitly is a one-shot redirect and does not need persistent connections.
q: 以下哪些是「实时通信/协作」类系统的共同技术要求？（多选）
q_en: Which requirements are common to realtime communication or collaboration systems? Select all that apply.
options: 服务器要能主动推送更新给客户端，而不是让客户端不停轮询
要维护每个用户当前是否在线、连接在哪个节点上的状态
多人同时修改同一份内容时，要有冲突合并策略
只需要每天批量生成一次汇总报表即可满足需求
why: 实时系统离不开服务器主动推送、连接状态管理，多人协作还要加一层冲突合并；批量报表是相反的离线思路。
why_en: Realtime systems need server push and connection-state tracking, and collaboration adds conflict merging, the opposite of a once-a-day batch report.
options_en: The server must actively push updates to clients instead of clients polling repeatedly.
The system must track whether each user is online and which node their connection lives on.
When multiple people edit the same content at once, there must be a conflict-merge strategy.
A once-a-day batch summary report is enough to meet the requirement.

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端和服务器保持打开的连接，服务器可随时主动推送。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A persistent connection stays open between client and server so the server can push updates at any time.

scenario: Uber、Yelp、本地配送服务都要回答「附近有什么」，LeetCode 判题完全不涉及用户地理位置。
scenario_en: Uber, Yelp, and local delivery all need to answer what is nearby, while a LeetCode judge does not use the user's physical location.
q: 以下哪些是「地理位置/邻近搜索」类系统的共同技术要求？（多选）
q_en: Which requirements are common to location or proximity-search systems? Select all that apply.
options: 需要按地理范围高效查询（如 geohash/quadtree 这类空间索引）
需要承受位置的高频更新（如司机坐标每几秒刷新一次）
需要把距离当作排序/匹配的一个因子
核心瓶颈是保存每次查询结果的历史版本
why: 地理类系统都靠空间索引做范围查询、扛住位置高频写入，并把距离纳入排序；保留历史版本不是共同瓶颈。
why_en: Location-based systems rely on spatial indexing for range queries, must absorb high-frequency location writes, and use distance as a ranking factor.
options_en: They need efficient range queries over geography (e.g. geohash/quadtree spatial indexes).
They must absorb high-frequency location updates (e.g. driver coordinates every few seconds).
They use distance as a ranking or matching factor.
The core bottleneck is storing historical versions of every query result.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把经纬度编码成一段字符串，前缀相同的区域彼此靠近，便于范围查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Geohash encodes latitude and longitude into a string where nearby areas share a common prefix, enabling range queries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种把二维空间递归四等分的树结构，用来加速空间范围查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quadtree is a tree that recursively splits 2D space into four quadrants to speed up spatial range queries.

scenario: Distributed Cache、Job Scheduler、Web Crawler 都是面向后端组件本身的 Hard 题，不是面向终端用户的产品功能。
scenario_en: Distributed Cache, Job Scheduler, and Web Crawler are Hard backend-infrastructure prompts, not end-user product features.
q: 以下「问题—核心难点」配对，哪些正确？（多选）
q_en: Which problem-to-core-challenge pairs are correct? Select all that apply.
options: Distributed Cache——核心难点是分片与副本一致性
Job Scheduler——核心难点是任务队列与 worker 池的调度解耦
Web Crawler——核心难点是抓取前沿队列与去重
三者的核心难点都是前端页面的样式适配
why: 三道基础设施题各自的难点都不同：分片一致性、队列调度、抓取去重；样式适配根本不是这类题的考点。
why_en: Each infrastructure problem has a distinct core challenge — sharding consistency, queue scheduling, and crawl dedupe — none of which is frontend styling.
options_en: Distributed Cache — the core challenge is sharding and replica consistency.
Job Scheduler — the core challenge is decoupling the task queue from the worker pool.
Web Crawler — the core challenge is the crawl frontier queue and deduplication.
All three problems' core challenge is frontend styling.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据按某个规则切分到多台机器上存储。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sharding splits data across multiple machines according to some partitioning rule.

termDefinitions.meaning: 爬虫里还没抓取、等待被访问的 URL 队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The crawl frontier is the queue of URLs a crawler has discovered but not yet visited.

scenario: FB News Feed、FB Live Comments、FB Post Search 都是 Meta 系产品在系统设计面试里的常见原型。
scenario_en: FB News Feed, FB Live Comments, and FB Post Search are common Meta-style product prompts in system design interviews.
q: 以下「问题—核心技术挑战」配对，哪些正确？（多选）
q_en: Which problem-to-core-technical-challenge pairs are correct? Select all that apply.
options: FB News Feed——核心挑战是好友关系的推送分发与排序
FB Live Comments——核心挑战是超高并发下的实时评论流分发
FB Post Search——核心挑战是全文/索引检索，而不是时间线排序
三者的核心挑战都是端到端加密密钥管理
why: News Feed 靠 fan-out 排序，Live Comments 靠高并发实时分发，Post Search 靠全文检索——三者挑战互不相同。
why_en: News Feed relies on fan-out ranking, Live Comments on high-concurrency realtime distribution, and Post Search on full-text indexing — three distinct challenges.
options_en: FB News Feed — the core challenge is friend-graph fan-out and ranking.
FB Live Comments — the core challenge is realtime comment distribution under extreme concurrency.
FB Post Search — the core challenge is full-text/index retrieval, not timeline ranking.
All three problems' core challenge is end-to-end encryption key management.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一条内容主动推送/写入到所有关注者的 feed 里的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fan-out is the process of pushing or writing one piece of content into every follower's feed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对文本内容建立倒排索引，支持按关键词快速查找。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Full-text search builds an inverted index over text content to support fast keyword lookup.

scenario: 目录里同时有「YouTube」和「YouTube Top K」两道 Hard 题，名字很像但考点完全不同。
scenario_en: The catalog has both YouTube and YouTube Top K as Hard prompts; their names are similar, but the tested skills are different.
q: YouTube Top K 这道题真正考的技术判断是什么？
q_en: What technical judgment does the YouTube Top K prompt actually test?
options: 视频上传后的多分辨率转码流水线设计
全球 CDN 边缘节点的选址与调度策略
海量事件流下的近似 Top-K 统计
用户账号的强一致性鉴权与会话管理
why: YouTube Top K 问的是海量播放事件里怎么近似算出当前最热门的 K 个视频，是流式计数问题，和视频存储转码无关。
why_en: YouTube Top K is really about approximately counting the current top-K most-watched videos from a massive event stream, unrelated to video storage or transcoding.
options_en: Designing the multi-resolution transcoding pipeline after video upload.
Choosing where and how to schedule global CDN edge nodes.
Approximate top-K counting over a massive event stream.
Strongly consistent account authentication and session management.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在海量数据流里出现频率特别高的那一小撮元素。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A heavy hitter is one of the small set of elements that appears unusually often in a massive data stream.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用少量内存近似统计数据流中元素出现频率的数据结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A count-min sketch is a data structure that approximates element frequencies in a data stream using very little memory.

scenario: ChatGPT 这道 Hard 题和 Web Crawler、Metrics Monitoring 这类经典基础设施 Hard 题归在同一档难度里。
scenario_en: The ChatGPT prompt is ranked Hard alongside classic infrastructure prompts like Web Crawler and Metrics Monitoring.
q: 相比 Web Crawler 这类经典基础设施题，设计 ChatGPT 这类 AI 产品多出的核心技术判断是什么？
q_en: Compared with a classic infrastructure prompt like Web Crawler, what extra technical judgment does a ChatGPT-style AI product add?
options: 要权衡模型推理延迟/吞吐，并管理会话上下文
完全不需要考虑存储和缓存这类基础设施
只是把实现语言换成另一种编程语言
和网络爬虫的技术挑战完全一样，只是名字不同
why: AI 产品多一层模型服务判断：推理延迟/吞吐怎么权衡、怎么流式吐 token、上下文怎么管理，这是传统爬虫题没有的。
why_en: AI product design adds a model-serving layer of judgment — inference latency versus throughput, streaming token generation, and context management — that classic crawling problems don't have.
options_en: You must trade off inference latency versus throughput and manage conversation context.
Storage and caching infrastructure are not a concern at all.
It just swaps in a different implementation language.
It has exactly the same technical challenges as a web crawler, just a different name.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用已经训练好的模型对新输入产出结果的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Inference is the process of running a trained model on new input to produce an output.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型边生成边逐个 token 返回，而不是等全部生成完再一次性返回。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Streaming generation returns tokens one at a time as the model produces them, instead of waiting for the full output.

scenario: 你想专项练习「并发争抢同一份有限资源」这类技术判断——锁、事务、串行化。
scenario_en: You want to specifically practice the judgment where many clients contend for the same limited resource: locks, transactions, and serialization.
q: 练并发争抢有限资源时，最适合的两道 Medium 题是？
q_en: When practicing contention over a limited resource, which two Medium problems are the best fit?
options: Ticketmaster 和 Online Auction
Bitly 和 Dropbox
Strava 和 Tinder
News Aggregator 和 LeetCode
why: 抢票和拍卖出价都是同一份资源被并发争抢，直接练锁、事务和串行化；其余选项都缺这层并发写冲突。
why_en: Ticket sales and auction bids both have many clients contending for the same limited resource, directly exercising locking, transactions, and serialization.
whenOtherWins: 想在更高难度下练一致性与并发，可进阶到 Hard 的 Robinhood 或 Payment System。
tradeoff: 并发争抢单一资源的锁/事务 vs 其他题型各自的技术判断
options_en: Ticketmaster and Online Auction.
Bitly and Dropbox.
Strava and Tinder.
News Aggregator and LeetCode.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个请求同时争夺同一份有限资源（如同一张票）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Contention is when multiple requests compete for the same limited resource at the same time, like one ticket.

scenario: Design LeetCode 要在页面里安全地运行任意用户提交的代码，再判断输出是否正确。
scenario_en: Design LeetCode needs to safely run arbitrary user-submitted code and then judge whether the output is correct.
q: Design LeetCode 的核心技术判断是什么？
q_en: What is the core technical judgment in Design LeetCode?
options: 只是一个带语法高亮的前端代码编辑器组件
要在隔离沙箱里安全运行不受信任的用户代码，并判定结果
核心是对题目内容做全文搜索索引
核心是对提交的代码做转码压缩
why: 用户提交的代码不可信，必须在资源受限、网络隔离的沙箱里跑完再收集结果，这是判题系统最核心的安全判断。
why_en: User-submitted code is untrusted, so it must run inside a resource-limited, network-isolated sandbox before results are collected.
options_en: It's just a frontend code editor component with syntax highlighting.
Untrusted user code must run safely inside an isolated sandbox, then be judged.
The core is building a full-text search index over problem statements.
The core is transcoding and compressing the submitted code.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个资源受限、和外部网络隔离的执行环境，用来安全运行不受信任的代码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sandbox is a resource-limited, network-isolated execution environment used to safely run untrusted code.

scenario: Strava（运动轨迹记录）和 Tinder（附近的人匹配）都要用到用户的地理位置。
scenario_en: Strava records exercise routes and Tinder matches nearby people, so both depend on user location.
q: Strava 和 Tinder 共同的地理位置判断是什么？
q_en: What location-based judgment do Strava and Tinder share?
options: 都需要基于地理位置做邻近查询或匹配
都需要强一致的金融对账
都需要处理视频转码与分发
都完全不涉及用户的位置更新
why: Strava 要按轨迹路径查附近路段，Tinder 要按距离匹配附近的人，两者都要靠空间索引做邻近查询。
why_en: Strava needs to look up nearby route segments and Tinder needs to match nearby people by distance, so both rely on spatial indexing for proximity queries.
options_en: Both need location-based proximity queries or matching.
Both need strongly consistent financial reconciliation.
Both need video transcoding and distribution.
Neither involves updating the user's location at all.

scenario: Robinhood（股票交易）和 Payment System（支付系统）都属于金融方向的 Hard 题。
scenario_en: Robinhood, a stock-trading prompt, and Payment System are both Hard financial-system prompts.
q: Robinhood 和 Payment System 共同的金融一致性判断是什么？
q_en: What financial consistency judgment do Robinhood and Payment System share?
options: 都以最终一致性为默认目标，优先换取更高吞吐
都主要考验静态资源的 CDN 缓存策略
都需要强一致性和幂等性，防止重复扣款或重复下单
都不需要处理并发写入
why: 钱和交易不能算错也不能算两次，两道题都必须靠强一致性和幂等性防止重复扣款或重复下单。
why_en: Money and trades can't be wrong or counted twice, so both problems need strong consistency and idempotency to prevent double charges or duplicate orders.
options_en: Both default to eventual consistency to prioritize higher throughput.
Both are mainly tested on static-asset CDN caching strategy.
Both need strong consistency and idempotency to prevent double charges or duplicate orders.
Neither needs to handle concurrent writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一个请求重复执行多次，结果和只执行一次一样。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotency means repeating the same request multiple times has the same effect as doing it once.

scenario: Ad Click Aggregator（广告点击聚合）和 Metrics Monitoring（指标监控）都要处理源源不断涌入的海量事件。
scenario_en: Ad Click Aggregator and Metrics Monitoring both handle a continuous high-volume stream of incoming events.
q: Ad Click Aggregator 和 Metrics Monitoring 共同的事件流判断是什么？
q_en: What event-streaming judgment do Ad Click Aggregator and Metrics Monitoring share?
options: 地理位置邻近搜索
海量事件流的实时聚合与近似统计
文件版本的强一致同步
端到端加密密钥分发
why: 两道题都要把源源不断的事件流实时聚合成统计结果，属于流处理/聚合方向，和 YouTube Top K 是同类判断。
why_en: Both problems must aggregate a continuous stream of events into statistics in real time, the same stream-processing family as YouTube Top K.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    Events["High-volume events"] --> Stream["Stream processing"]
    Stream --> Agg["Aggregation"]
    Agg --> Store["Query store / dashboard"]
options_en: Geographic proximity search.
Realtime aggregation and approximate statistics over massive event streams.
Strongly consistent file version syncing.
End-to-end encryption key distribution.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据一到达就立刻处理，而不是攒成批次再处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stream processing handles data as soon as it arrives instead of waiting to process it in batches.

scenario: 你的目标公司常考「设计一个聊天/消息系统」，要挑一道有完整拆解的题精练实时消息与在线状态。
scenario_en: Your target company often asks for a chat or messaging system, and you want one full breakdown to practice realtime delivery and presence.
q: 练聊天/消息系统时，最对口的拆解题是哪道？
q_en: When practicing a chat or messaging system, which breakdown is the closest match?
options: News Aggregator
WhatsApp
Price Tracking Service
Job Scheduler
why: WhatsApp 直接覆盖实时消息投递、在线状态这些聊天系统的核心判断，其余三道都是完全不同的技术方向。
why_en: WhatsApp directly covers realtime message delivery and presence, the core judgments of a chat system, while the other problems test unrelated directions.
whenOtherWins: 想练「高扇出的直播评论流」选 FB Live Comments；想练协同编辑选 Google Docs。
tradeoff: 实时消息投递 + 在线状态（WhatsApp） vs 其他题各自的技术方向
options_en: News Aggregator.
WhatsApp.
Price Tracking Service.
Job Scheduler.

termDefinitions.meaning: 标记用户当前是否在线、最近活跃时间的状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Presence is the status that shows whether a user is currently online and when they were last active.

q: 补全四道 Easy 入门系统设计题：
q_en: Fill in the four Easy starter system design prompts:
text: 四道 Easy：{{Bitly}}（短链）、{{Dropbox}}（文件同步）、Local Delivery Service（{{Gopuff}}）、News Aggregator（Google News）。
why: 这四道各自把判断收窄到一个孤立的核心技能——编码重定向、版本元数据、地理+库存匹配、内容聚合。
why_en: Each easy problem isolates one core skill — redirect encoding, version metadata, geo-plus-inventory matching, or content aggregation — before stacking on more constraints.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把长网址映射成短字符串的服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A short link service maps a long URL to a short string.

scenario: Online Chess 里两名玩家要实时对弈，任何一步棋都要让对方立刻看到，还要防止非法走子。
scenario_en: In Online Chess, two players play in real time; each move must appear to the other player quickly, and illegal moves must be blocked.
q: Online Chess 的核心技术判断是什么？
q_en: What is the core technical judgment in Online Chess?
options: 对局记录做强一致的批量离线归档即可
核心是给棋盘图片做 CDN 缓存
核心是给用户账号做支付对账
低延迟的走子状态同步，加上服务端合法性校验
why: 两人对弈要求走子几乎实时可见，且不能信任客户端上报的棋步，所以核心是低延迟同步加服务端校验。
why_en: A two-player game needs moves to appear almost instantly and can't trust the client's reported move, so the core is low-latency sync plus server-side legality checks.
options_en: A strongly consistent batch offline archive of the game record is enough.
The core is CDN caching of board images.
The core is payment reconciliation for user accounts.
Low-latency move-state synchronization plus server-side legality validation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务端独立检查一步棋是否符合规则，而不是只信任客户端。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Legality validation means the server independently checks whether a move follows the rules instead of trusting the client.
